proposed_widenings.name: per_effect_charge_cost
proposed_widenings.justification: Tree Form costs exactly 1 charge from the staff's shared 6-charge pool, but the current surface has no way to attach a fixed charge cost to a non-spell effect atom (alter_item_kind) within an ActivatedAbilityMechanics. The charge_cast mode on grant_spell_access handles per-spell charge costs, but no analogous mechanism exists for other EffectAtoms. Both Tree Form and the 8 spells draw from the same pool; separate composite parts would create disconnected pools, which is structurally wrong.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Magic action to plant one end of the staff in earth in an unoccupied space and expend 1 charge to transform the staff into a healthy tree.

proposed_widenings.name: equipment_predicate_transformed_state
proposed_widenings.justification: The Tree Form revert requires touching the tree (the transformed staff) while using a Magic action. This is a conditional predicate on the item's current form/state, which isn't representable as a holding_item, wearing_item, or any existing EquipmentPredicate variant. It requires knowing whether the item is in its transformed state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While touching the tree and using a Magic action, you return the staff to its normal form.

notes: The passive bonuses (+2 weapon attack, +2 weapon damage with staff, +2 spell attack rolls) and all 8 charge-based spells encode cleanly — the spell_attack_roll RollKind was added specifically for this item per the types.ts comment. Tree Form (alter_item_kind with 1 charge) and its revert are omitted as surface_widening. The spell_attack_roll bucket separating spell attacks from weapon attacks is correctly exercised here.
